summary: Implemented 10 of 11 phases of the plan to route every specs/state.json writer through one mutex-guarded helper. Built agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/state-write.sh (fail-closed acquire, private mktemp staging, jq empty validation, optional in-mutex TODO.md regen, SCOPE_MUTEX_HELD guest mode) and its isolated-temp-root concurrency suite (4/4 passing); added task-lock.sh cmd_release ownership verification; converted all nine originally-scoped writer scripts (manage-topics.sh, reconcile-artifacts.sh, archive-task.sh, reconcile-task-status.sh, orchestrate-predispatch-review.sh, skill-base.sh, update-task-status.sh, orchestrator-postflight.sh) plus both inline command-file writes (implement.md, review.md); made the workflow-active marker per-session (keyed by Claude Code's native session UUID) as one atomic batch across its writer and three consumers, verified with a two-session fixture. Manually deployed state-write.sh and its test suite to the live .claude/scripts/ (the one explicit deploy workaround the plan authorized). Phase 11's own audit gate -- a repo-wide grep proving zero hand-rolled specs/state.json tmp-and-mv sequences remain outside state-write.sh -- was run in full but FAILED: it surfaced thirteen core SKILL.md files (skill-implementer, skill-implementer-hard, skill-planner, skill-planner-hard, skill-researcher, skill-researcher-hard, skill-reviser, skill-spawn, skill-status-sync, skill-team-implement, skill-team-plan, skill-team-research, skill-todo) plus six additional command-file sites (commands/task.md, commands/todo.md) with their own unconverted inline writes -- a scope gap in the plan's originating research report, not a defect in any completed phase. Recorded honestly as a follow-up rather than silently converted (uncosted, multi-phase-sized additional work) or silently omitted.
decisions_made: state-write.sh is a standalone invocable script, not a sourced function, matching the dominant convention for single-purpose state mutation and callable from both shell scripts and markdown bash blocks.

The helper's interface is an arbitrary jq filter plus --arg/--argjson passthrough, because the three real caller transform shapes (single-task field update, top-level array mutation, $cands-scoped bulk |=) cannot be expressed by a narrow task_number+field API.
Mutex acquire is fail-closed on timeout, adopting task-lock.sh's cmd_scope_acquire return-2 precedent; the two existing callers' WARNING-and-proceed fallback is removed, not preserved as an option.
skill-base.sh's two orphaned uncalled write functions are deleted rather than converted; only orchestrator-postflight.sh's live inline duplicates of that logic are converted.
cmd_release's ownership check is WARN-and-no-op, always return 0, mirroring cmd_scope_release exactly rather than force-refusing.
The workflow-active writer and all three consumers are one atomic-batch phase; a partial conversion reintroduces the hazard.
The extension-loader deploy gap is worked around with an explicit manual copy phase and recorded as still open, not fixed by this plan.

Several converted scripts had no session_id parameter at all (or dozens of pre-existing callers passing none); rather than thread a required parameter through every caller, each gained a self-generating --session-id fallback (same portable pattern command-gate-in.sh uses), keeping every existing caller working unchanged.

orchestrator-postflight.sh's Stage 7-8a bracket is kept for its all-stages-atomic property, but its own acquire was additionally converted from fail-open to a graceful per-stage fail-closed degradation on a bracket-timeout, beyond the plan's literal task-list wording, for consistency with the plan's system-wide fail-closed goal and to pass Phase 11's fail-open-wording audit.

The workflow-active marker is keyed by Claude Code's native session UUID ($CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID / hook stdin's .session_id), not the agent-system sess_... session_id, since that is the only identifier both the writer and all three hook consumers can independently resolve.

Phase 11's zero-hits audit gate was run in full and its failure is recorded honestly (specific file list) rather than either silently expanding scope to convert everything found or silently declaring the phase complete despite the gate's own explicit non-negotiable wording.
follow_up_needed: Spawn a new task to convert the residual specs/state.json write surface discovered during this task's Phase 11 audit: thirteen core SKILL.md files (skill-implementer, skill-implementer-hard, skill-planner, skill-planner-hard, skill-researcher, skill-researcher-hard, skill-reviser, skill-spawn, skill-status-sync, skill-team-implement, skill-team-plan, skill-team-research, skill-todo) plus additional sites in commands/task.md and commands/todo.md, all still using hand-rolled jq/mv or specs/state.json.tmp patterns instead of state-write.sh. Also: run a full 'Load Core'/'Sync all' pass to bring the live .claude/ deploy in sync with every file this task edited (only state-write.sh and test-state-write-concurrency.sh were manually deployed).
